title: Structured Data Extractor (Schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, Product Prices)
description: Pull the machine-readable data out of any web page: schema.org JSON-LD, microdata types, Open Graph and Twitter cards, product name/price/stock/rating, organisation contact details, articles, breadcrumbs and FAQs. Bulk URLs, errors free.

urls.title: Page URLs
urls.description: Pages to read, one per line (up to 10,000 per run).

includeRawJsonLd.title: Include raw JSON-LD
includeRawJsonLd.description: Also return every JSON-LD node as found on the page (up to 50 per page).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.

page.title: Page read
page.description: One page fetched and its structured data extracted. Unreachable, blocked, non-HTML or error pages are free.

store.seoDescription: Extract JSON-LD, schema.org types, Open Graph, product prices, stock, ratings and organisation details from any URL in bulk.
